findings.summary: The link's aria-label replaces its visible brand text, so its accessible name does not include “Fullbright,” making it harder to identify by speech input.
findings.fix: Remove aria-label so the link name comes from its visible text, or use an aria-label that begins with “Fullbright Integrated School Management.”

findings.summary: The overview fragment link is marked as the current page and remains so after navigation to other dashboard sections, misreporting the current location to assistive technology.
findings.fix: Use aria-current="location" for the link matching the current fragment, and update it when the fragment changes; omit it when no link represents the current location.

passed: The menu toggle is a native button with a visible accessible name; aria-controls references the existing dashboard-sidebar ID.
aria-expanded is initialized and updated by the toggle script, including reset on Escape and viewport changes.
The aria-labelledby references, skip-link target, and dashboard fragment targets resolve to IDs in the shared layout.
